import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load(); neg=model.negatives()
mem=[6,8,9,54,58,59,61,63]
uids=neg['uid']
T=[]
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for i in mem:
    xi0=neg['xi'][i]; c=float(neg['c'][i])
    Z=xi0+rng.normal(size=(1024,2))*0.6
    Z=np.concatenate([xi0[None],Z]).astype(np.float32)
    a=model.decode(net,torch.tensor(Z),torch.full((len(Z),),c))
    a=np.asarray(a[0] if isinstance(a,tuple) else a)
    inb=np.asarray(model.in_basin(i,a)).astype(bool)
    r=np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1)
    ok=(~inb)&(r>1.8)&(r<3.4)
    d=np.linalg.norm(Z-xi0,axis=1); d[~ok]=1e9
    j=np.argsort(d)[:5]
    tgt=a[j].mean(0) if np.std(a[j],0).max()<0.4 else a[j[0]]
    print(int(uids[i]),round(c,3),'self inb',inb[0],np.round(a[0],2),'frac bad',inb.mean().round(2),'tgt',np.round(tgt,2),'dxi',np.round(d[j[0]],2))
    T.append(tgt)
T=np.array(T,np.float32); np.save('rescue.npy',T); print(T.shape)

import numpy as np, model
neg=model.negatives(); mem=[6,8,9,54,58,59,61,63]
T=np.load('rescue.npy'); out=[]
for t,i in zip(T,mem):
    b=model.basin(i); P=b['pts']; L=b['lab']
    best=None
    for l in np.unique(L):
        if l==b['bad'] or l<0: continue
        Q=P[L==l]; 
        if len(Q)<5: continue
        cen=Q.mean(0); q=Q[np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(Q-cen,axis=1))]
        d=np.linalg.norm(q-t)
        if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,q,l,len(Q))
    print(int(neg['uid'][i]),np.round(t,2),'->',np.round(best[1],2),'lab',best[2],best[3],'badc',np.round(P[L==b['bad']].mean(0),2))
    out.append(best[1])
np.save('rescue2.npy',np.array(out,np.float32))
